rules.statement: A court is not precluded from issuing an injunction under section 86 of the Courts Ordinance in proceedings under the Partition Act.
rules.supporting_quote: We are unable to uphold that contention. There is nothing in the Partition Act which precludes a court from issuing an injunction under that section of the Courts Ordinance in proceedings under that Act. The terms of section 86 of the Courts Ordinance are very wide. It provides that an injunction may be issued 'in any action instituted in any District Court or Court of Requests'.
